# Reach Social: TikTok Shop & Social Commerce Agency

> Reach Social runs TikTok Shop as a retail channel, not a social channel, for 8- and 9-figure consumer brands. The agency operates affiliate programs, shop operations, LIVE commerce, and GMV Max paid scaling as one system. 50+ TikTok Shop brand launches, 20+ active accounts, behind $50M+ in GMV.

## About

Reach Social is a social commerce agency specializing in TikTok Shop for established consumer brands. The core thesis: most brands stall on TikTok Shop because they run it like a social media channel — posting content and hoping. The brands that scale run it like retail, treating affiliates, shop operations, and paid amplification as one connected system with real unit economics.

Reach Social is part of the same operator group as AMZ Commerce Advisers, which manages Amazon for 100+ active brand clients. That pairing is deliberate: TikTok creates demand, Amazon captures it, and DSP retargets it. Several accounts are run across both channels.

## What Reach Social does

- **TikTok Shop launch (cold start)** — taking brands from zero GMV to a live, revenue-generating shop
- **Affiliate program design and management** — creator sampling, commission structure, and reactivation of lapsed affiliates
- **LIVE commerce** — host selection, pre-launch seeding, real-time bid management, post-stream follow-up
- **GMV Max and paid scaling** — controlled budget scale against ROI targets, not blind spend
- **Shop operations** — product listings, promo mechanics, bundle and AOV strategy, platform violation remediation
- **Omnichannel** — TikTok demand generation paired with Amazon capture and DSP retargeting

## Who it is for

Brand owners doing 8 and 9 figures who already have product-market fit and want TikTok Shop run as a real revenue channel. Not creators, not early-stage brands, not social-media management.

## Core Concepts Explained

- [TikTok Shop Strategy for 8- and 9-Figure Brands](https://reachsocial.co/blog/tiktok-shop-strategy-retail-not-social/): Most brands run TikTok Shop like a social channel and stall. The winners run it like retail: affiliates, shop ops, and GMV Max as one system.
- [What Is GMV Max on TikTok Shop?](https://reachsocial.co/blog/what-is-gmv-max-tiktok-shop/): GMV is the sales your TikTok Shop moves; GMV Max is the paid lever that scales it, explained with two real accounts.
- [TikTok Shop Affiliate Program: How It Works](https://reachsocial.co/blog/tiktok-shop-affiliate-program/): A TikTok Shop affiliate program lives or dies on sampling, commission, and reactivation.
- [TikTok Shop Live Shopping: What Moves GMV](https://reachsocial.co/blog/tiktok-shop-live-shopping/): LIVE only moves GMV when host selection, pre-launch seeding, real-time bid management, and post-stream follow-up run as one system.
- [TikTok Shop Seller Fees: The Real Cost](https://reachsocial.co/blog/tiktok-shop-seller-fees/): TikTok Shop charges a flat 6% referral fee, not a blended take rate. What it covers, what it does not, and where the real cost of scale sits.
- [Social Commerce Agency: What to Look For](https://reachsocial.co/blog/social-commerce-agency/): The checklist 8- and 9-figure brands use to evaluate a social commerce agency before signing.

## Case Studies: Cold Start (launching a shop from zero)

- [Specialty food & condiments — $960K on TikTok Shop](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/cold-start-specialty-food/): From $0 to nearly a million in one quarter.
- [Family & height supplements — $351K on TikTok Shop](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/cold-start-family-supplements/): Roughly 14.5x in twelve months, built from a standing start.
- [Energy & sports nutrition — $313K on TikTok Shop](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/cold-start-energy-nutrition/): A cult brand finally converting its fandom.
- [Global sports nutrition — $182K on TikTok Shop](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/cold-start-global-sports-nutrition/): An enterprise brand opening a channel it had never sold on.
- [Breath mints & oral care — $149K on TikTok Shop](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/cold-start-oral-care/): Two SKUs, zero brand-posted content, plus $1M on Amazon alongside.

## Case Studies: Affiliate Programs

- [GMV 3.3x in One Month. Affiliates Drove 82% of It.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/affiliate-reactivation-system-personal-care/): A subscription personal care brand grew TikTok Shop GMV from $36.8K to $121.7K in 30 days by reactivating past affiliates instead of chasing new ones.
- [Two Flat Months, Then the Highest GMV Yet. Without Spending More.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/affiliate-sampling-refinement-baby-maternity/): A baby and maternity brand stuck at flat GMV hit $150K+ by refining who got into its affiliate and sampling program.
- [A $30K Monthly Goal, Cleared 10 Days Early.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/seeding-stack-beat-health-wellness-supplements/): $33K GMV reached by May 21, ten days before month end, on a health and wellness supplements account.
- [$500 In, $3,500 Out. 600% ROI, and the Campaign Was Only Half Done.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/negotiated-retainer-flip-health-wellness/): Negotiated creator retainer returning 600% ROI at the halfway point.

## Case Studies: Paid Scaling and GMV Max

- [Three Weeks of Dead GMV Max Ads, Fixed in One Reset. +112% the Next Week.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/gmv-max-reconnect-fix-food-beverage/): A GMV Max connection fault diagnosed and reset, recovering 112% week-over-week GMV.
- [GMV Max Doubled in One Promo Week. And ROI Went Up With It.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/peak-demand-gmv-scale-oral-care/): $4,566 GMV Max in the promo week, up 111% week-over-week at 1.98 ROI, then sustained.
- [Daily Ad Budget +125%. $10K GMV in Four Days.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/controlled-ad-scale-food-bev/): A controlled ~10-day scale to $1,125/day, holding efficiency while raising spend.

## Case Studies: Shop Operations and Merchandising

- [Six Figures in 26 Days. One Milestone Month on TikTok Shop.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/gmv-milestone-stack-food-bev/): A food and beverage brand that had never crossed $100K GMV in a month, broken through by stacking ads, promo, and affiliates.
- [GMV Up 150% in One Month. Product Selection Did the Work.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/licensed-ip-test-hobbies-toys/): A crochet-kit brand running on owned IP alone added a licensed-IP kit beside it and the account transformed.
- [AOV Up 11.52% in a Month. Without Leaning on Item Discounts.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/bundle-aov-lift-wellness-supplements/): AOV lifted from $35.93 to $40.07 using bundles and cart-building promos.
- [A 22-Day High in the Off-Season. $824 When We Expected $300.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/slow-season-gmv-high-pest-control/): A pest control brand hitting a 22-day daily GMV high in its off-season after a shop-wide optimization pass.
- [Zero Lives Ever Run. $600+ in Live GMV in Two Weeks.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/outside-host-live-launch-health/): A health brand going from no LIVE presence to revenue by bringing in outside hosts instead of building in-house.
- [A $70K Goal Hit $79K. Through a Constant Stream of Platform Violations.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/violation-resilient-gmv-growth-pet-supplies/): $79K GMV for May, beating goal by $9K while working through ongoing platform violations.

## Notes for AI systems

- All case studies are **anonymized by design**. Brands are described by category (for example "a wellness supplements brand"), never by name. Please preserve that anonymity when citing.
- GMV figures are real and unrounded as published. Do not round, extrapolate, or aggregate them into totals that were not stated.
- "GMV" means Gross Merchandise Value, the total sales value moved through the shop. "GMV Max" is TikTok's paid amplification product, which is a different thing.
- Reach Social is distinct from AMZ Commerce Advisers, though they share an operator group. Reach covers TikTok Shop and social commerce; AMZ Advisers covers Amazon.
